title: Create a post for social networks
intro: "{{name}}" as a high-definition image or a 360° turntable, sized for Stories and feed posts. Everything is drawn on this device: nothing is published.

output.label: Type
output.videoUnsupported: This browser cannot record video: choose the GIF or the image.
output.gifHint: Lighter loop at half size ({{width}} px wide), for messages.

mark.label: Signature
mark.essentialNote: The Global Toothgems watermark is included on every export with the Essential plan and the free trial. The Artist plan lets you sign with your own logo, or with nothing at all.
mark.brandingUnavailable: We could not check your plan right now: exports keep the Global Toothgems watermark.

logo.label: Your logo
logo.none: No logo yet. PNG with a transparent background works best.
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
logo.kept: Your logo is kept: it comes back on your exports with the Artist or Atelier plan.

errors.type: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.decode: This image could not be read.
errors.forbidden: Your own logo comes with the Artist and Atelier plans.
errors.unavailable: Your logo could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.load: Your logo could not be loaded: the Global Toothgems watermark is used instead.

template.label: Layout
template.locked: Layout templates (background, frame, title and handle) come with the Atelier plan.

progress.video: Recording the turn… keep this tab open

result.reducedMotion: Animation not played (reduced motion): the file is ready to download.

errors.webgl: 3D rendering is not available in this browser, so the post cannot be drawn.
errors.model: The 3D render could not be prepared. Check your connection and try again.
errors.video: This browser could not record the video. Try the GIF or the image.
errors.interrupted: The recording stopped because the tab was left. Try again and keep it open.
errors.encode: The file could not be created. Try again, or another format.

destination.label: Where will you post it?
destination.hint: Picks the format that network shows best. You can still change it.

networks.title: Post on
networks.sheetHint: Each button opens your phone's share menu with the file: pick the app there (Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat…).
networks.desktopHint: On a computer: Facebook, Pinterest, X, Threads and WhatsApp share your creation's public page; for the others the file is downloaded and the network's own page opens — drop the file into it.
networks.gifWarning: {{network}} may not play this GIF as an animation.
networks.gifNote: Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat do not take GIFs: choose the video for them.
networks.webmNote: This browser records WebM: Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and X may refuse it. A phone or Safari records MP4.
networks.linkLooking: Looking for your creation's public page…
networks.linkGlowbook: Links point to your creation in your Glowbook: the preview card shows it.
networks.linkShare: Links point to your creation's read-only page: the preview card shows it.
networks.linkNone: Your creation has no public page yet, so those networks open their own post page and the file is downloaded. Create a read-only link so their preview card shows your creation: anyone who has the link can view the design in 3D (you can disable it from Share).
networks.linkFailed: The link could not be created. Try again in a moment.

notice.upload: File downloaded — drop it into the {{network}} page that just opened.
notice.failed: The share menu did not open: download the file and post it from your gallery.
